claim: Ladies who are around 5', how many calories do you really eat?
summary: I eat right around 1,200 calories a day and my TDEE is about 1,600. I also run a couple times a week in addition to just being really active chasing two kids around all day. I keep within my macros but still don't lose weight. I know they advise against eating less than 1200 calories a day, but does this apply to women who are short as well?
